description: Seed state for the loopback VCF Operations for Networks appliance stand-in. The mock reads this once at start-up; it never mutates the file.

tokens.comment: Tokens are handed out in this order. The first one is revoked by the appliance once it has served 'revoke_after_successful_creates' successful addApplicationWithTiers calls, which is what forces a mid-run re-authentication. 'expiry' is the advertised expiry the appliance reports; the appliance may revoke a session before it.

pagination.comment: The appliance caps a listApplications page at this many results regardless of the requested size, so a client must follow the cursor to see every application.

created_application.comment: Template for the Application object returned by addApplicationWithTiers. entity_id is allocated from next_entity_id_seq.
